description: Regression evals for the naturalness judge's idiomatic_phrasing axis. Each seed is a REAL unidiomatic form caught by human review in this session (source_commit) paired with its correction. A 'bad' text should score LOW on idiomatic_phrasing for the intended_meaning; the 'good' text should score high. promotion_candidate=false means the seed is useful as an advisory sensitivity probe but too mild/context-sensitive to justify a load-bearing floor by itself. Not fabricated: every pair is a diff hunk from the cited fix commit.

seeds.good: Dere hører dere selv på opptaket.
seeds.intended_meaning: You hear yourselves on the recording.
seeds.note: The 'hear oneself' reflexive idiom requires obligatory 'selv' (høre seg/deg/meg SELV). Without it the sentence is ungrammatical, not merely awkward.

seeds.good: De hører seg selv på opptaket.
seeds.intended_meaning: They hear themselves on the recording.
seeds.note: Same 'høre seg selv' idiom in 3rd person plural; 'seg' alone drops the required intensifier 'selv'.

seeds.good: Jeg hører meg selv på opptaket.
seeds.intended_meaning: I hear myself on the recording.
seeds.note: 1st person: 'høre meg selv'; omitting 'selv' is ungrammatical.
'kjenne seg selv' = know oneself; bare 'kjenne seg' reads as 'feel (a certain way)' and does not carry the intended reflexive-knowing sense.

seeds.bad: Vi vet at butikken stenger seks.
seeds.good: Vi vet at butikken stenger klokka seks.
seeds.intended_meaning: We know that the shop closes at six o'clock.
seeds.note: A clock time as a point-in-time adverbial takes 'klokka' (stenger KLOKKA seks). Bare 'stenger seks' is unidiomatic for 'closes at six'.
